list.summary: List favorites in their user-defined order (ID and name in text mode).
list.data: Array of favorite objects (full API payload).

start.summary: Start the clock with a favorite.

arguments.name: id
arguments.description: Favorite ID. Without it a bash select picker is shown (text mode only).

notes: --dry-run reports the POST without sending it.
start.data: API response without data wrapper; the started entry is in .running.
